question: A man makes a monthly payment equal to 36% of his monthly salary towards debt repayment. He spends 50% of the remaining salary and saves ₹704. His monthly salary (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **Monthly Salary** be 100%.

Debt payment = 36% → Remaining = 64%.

Spending = 50% of 64% = 32% → Savings = 64% − 32% = 32%.

32% = ₹704 ⇒ 1% = 22 ⇒ 100% = ₹2200.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50bed8ee1de0502e863b25acb7d47bbdbf0ff8571825d52cebf0dc186f093a5d.png] 

**Given:**

Debt Repayment = 36% of **Monthly Salary**

Savings = ₹704 (which is 50% of the **Remaining Salary**)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Salary = S

⇒ Remaining Salary = S − (0.36 × S) = 0.64S

⇒ Savings = 50% of 0.64S = 0.50 × 0.64S = 0.32S

⇒ 0.32S = 704

⇒ S = 704 ÷ 0.32

⇒ S = 70400 ÷ 32

⇒ S = 2200

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is reduced by x% and then the remainder is reduced by y%, the final value is Base × (1 − x/100) × (1 − y/100).

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To simplify calculations, use 36% = 9/25 and 50% = 1/2. Remaining = (1 − 9/25) = 16/25. Savings = 1/2 × 16/25 = 8/25.

Concept of Remaining Value

Always calculate the next percentage on the **updated base** unless specified as percentage of total income.
